### Executive Summary

Alireza Lotfi is an Iranian software engineer with over 5 continuous years of enterprise experience (since 2021 / 1400 SH) at Nedapardaz Informatics. He specializes in designing, building, and maintaining high-reliability backend services, distributed queuing engines, desktop management suites, and hardware-software bridges. His software is running in thousands of live bank branches across Iran, directly processing queue tickets, biometric authentications, and transactional workloads for hundreds of thousands of citizens daily.

In addition to deep expertise in C#, .NET 9, SQL Server, and WPF, Alireza is an active practitioner of AI-Augmented Engineering (Vibe Coding), leveraging cutting-edge LLMs and agentic development workflows to ship commercial cross-platform software (such as the Nava Music Player published on Cafe Bazaar and Myket).

## 2. Technical Stack & Architecture Competencies

### 2.1 Backend & Architecture
- **Languages**: C# (.NET Framework 4.8 through .NET 8 / .NET 9), Dart, TypeScript, SQL, Python, Shell scripting.
- **Frameworks & Web**: ASP.NET Core WebAPI, Minimal APIs, SignalR Hubs (WebSockets / real-time bi-directional messaging), RESTful API design.
- **Architectural Paradigms**: Clean Architecture, Domain-Driven Design (DDD) fundamentals, CQRS, Event-Driven Architecture, Microservices, Stale-While-Revalidate caching.
- **Message Brokers & Distributed Tools**: RabbitMQ (Publish/Subscribe, Worker Queues, Routing Keys), Redis (Distributed Caching, Session Management), Dapr (Distributed Application Runtime - learning & exploring).
- **Security & Identity**: JWT (JSON Web Tokens) with active session invalidation middleware, HTTPS/TLS hardening, HSTS enforcement, RBAC (Role-Based Access Control).

### 2.2 Desktop, Win32 & Hardware Interfacing
- **GUI Frameworks**: WPF (Windows Presentation Foundation with MVVM pattern), WinForms, WebView2 (embedded modern Chromium web renderers).
- **Hardware Integration**:
  - **Biometric Scanners**: Suprema Fingerprint Scanners (via native C# wrapper FingerScanner.Sdk and SourceAFIS template matching).
  - **Document Scanners**: Windows Image Acquisition (WIA SDK) for high-speed automated document scanning and digital archiving.
  - **Thermal Printers**: ESC/POS thermal receipt printers (direct USB, Serial, and Network printing).
  - **Industrial I/O**: RS485 / RS232 Serial Port communication with branch button stands and hardware control units.
  - **Multimedia & Displays**: Multi-monitor video output engines for TV waiting hall queue announcement displays with text-to-speech (TTS) and pre-recorded wave audio synthesis.

### 2.3 Databases & Data Engineering
- **Database Engine**: Microsoft SQL Server (2014 through 2022).
- **Core Database Skills**:
  - Relational schema modeling and normal form optimization.
  - Advanced T-SQL writing (stored procedures, views, triggers, window functions).
  - Query execution plan analysis, index profiling, deadlock resolution, and high-concurrency transaction isolation.
- **Object-Relational Mapping**: Entity Framework Core (EF Core), Dapper (for micro-ORM high-throughput scenarios).

### 2.4 Frontend, Mobile & Cross-Platform
- **Web Frontend**: Vue.js 3 (Composition API, `<script setup>`, Pinia state management, Vue Router).
- **Mobile & Desktop**: Flutter & Dart (Cross-platform builds for Android and native Windows Desktop Runner).
- **Styling & Assets**: Vanilla CSS3, Responsive Design, CSS Grid, Flexbox, Variable Fonts (Peyda Variable Font).
- **PWA & Offline**: Progressive Web App architecture, custom Service Workers, Offline-first caching strategies.

## 3. Detailed Project Catalog

### Project 1: Nedapardaz Banking Queue & Branch Automation Platform
- **Identifier**: `legacy-queue-systems` / ID: 104
- **Client & Deployment**: Nedapardaz Informatics / Deployed across major Iranian banks (Bank Mellat, Bank Ayandeh, Bank Shahr, and corporate centers).
- **Role**: Software Engineer & Systems Support Specialist (2021 — Present, 5+ continuous years).
- **Scale**: Hundreds of branches nationwide, serving over 100,000 daily bank visitors.
- **Technologies**: C#, WPF, WinForms, SQL Server, Serial/RS485 Communication, ESC/POS Thermal Printing, REST APIs.
- **Architectural Overview**:
  1. *Customer Touchpoints*: WPF-based touch ticket kiosks with interactive service selection, national ID card input, and thermal receipt printing.
  2. *Hardware Control Unit Bridge*: Hardware control units interfaced via RS485/Serial ports to capture button presses from customer counters.
  3. *Teller Counter Clients (Teller Units)*: Desktop client software used by bank clerks to call next customers, transfer tickets between counters, manage priority queues, and report operational status.
  4. *TV Hall Display Engine*: Dedicated multi-screen display rendering live queue status and feeding real-time audio announcements.
  5. *Remote Reservation Service*: Online ticket reservation backend integrated with Bank Mellat web services.
- **Engineering Challenges Solved**:
  - Zero-downtime tolerance during peak morning bank hours.
  - Real-time serialization of concurrent ticket requests preventing duplicate ticket IDs across distributed kiosk stations.
  - Reliable recovery of hardware serial port disconnects without crashing kiosk user interfaces.

### Project 2: Biodaru Real-Time QMS & Biometric Verification Suite
- **Identifier**: `biodaru-qms` / ID: 105
- **Client & Deployment**: Biodaru Plasma Donation Centers.
- **Role**: Full-Stack Backend & Client-Side Engineer (April 2024 — Present).
- **Status**: Live in production operations.
- **Technologies**: C#, .NET 9, ASP.NET Core, SignalR Hubs, Vue.js 3, TypeScript, Pinia, WPF, WebView2, Suprema SDK, WIA SDK, SQL Server.
- **Architectural Overview**:
  - *ClientAgent Service*: Local desktop service running on `127.0.0.1:5050` interfacing with Suprema biometric fingerprint hardware and WIA document scanners.
  - *Frontend Application*: Vue 3 SPA loaded via WebView2 for desktop terminals and web browsers for admin stations.
  - *Backend & Real-time Synchronization*: ASP.NET Core WebAPI with SignalR WebSocket hub synchronizing state between registration kiosks, reception, examination physicians, waiting halls, and customer satisfaction survey stations.
- **Engineering Highlights**:
  - Secure biometric identity verification to prevent multiple unauthorized plasma donations within restricted safety intervals.
  - Sub-100ms real-time propagation of donor queue updates across all clinic stations using SignalR.

### Project 3: Nava Music Player (موزیک پلیر نوا)
- **Identifier**: `nava-music-player` / ID: 106
- **Category**: Commercial Mobile App / AI-Augmented (Vibe Coding) Showcase.
- **Platforms**: Android (published on official stores) & Windows Native Desktop.
- **Status**: Officially published on Cafe Bazaar and Myket app stores.
- **Package ID**: `com.damoon.nava.music`
- **Store Links**:
  - [Cafe Bazaar Link](https://cafebazaar.ir/app/com.damoon.nava.music)
  - [Myket Link](https://myket.ir/app/com.damoon.nava.music)
- **Technologies**: Flutter, Dart, JustAudio, AudioService (Android Foreground Service), Windows Desktop Runner, Hive DB.
- **Engineering Highlights**:
  - Complete audio lifecycle management (audio focus interruptions, incoming phone call pauses, lock-screen notifications, headset plug/unplug events).
  - Demonstration of production-grade AI-augmented development (Vibe Coding) delivering a polished, store-approved commercial app.

### Project 4: Biodaru Employee Training & Assessment Suite
- **Identifier**: `biodaroo-training-suite` / ID: 102
- **Technologies**: C#, ASP.NET Core WebAPI, Vue.js, SQL Server.
- **Functionality**: Complete digitalization of corporate training curricula, online timed multiple-choice and descriptive examinations, auto-grading, and employee certification analytics.

### Project 5: NeuroFlow Platform (R&D Architecture Concept)
- **Identifier**: `neuroflow-platform` / ID: 101
- **Focus**: Research & exploration of high-throughput asynchronous message broker patterns.
- **Technologies**: C#, .NET Worker Services, RabbitMQ, Redis, PostgreSQL / SQL Server.
- **Key Patterns**: Event-driven architecture, decouple request ingestion from heavy backend processing, rate limiting, and resilient retry queues.
